review_description: Amazing team and amazing results! Power bill went from $6000+ to less than $1500. We are extremely please with with the product and the Sun Solar team.

No issues with the install or quote. Cheap and easy, Passed all inspections and is working well. However once they had their money put little to no effort in helping me get the system connected to the grid. Electricians didnt show up to truck appointments costing me money with no show fees. Mutliple paper work issues. I still havent been connected to the grid 9 months after install. Get what you pay for i guess.

Got 5 Quotes. Space Solar insisted that they must do a site inspection one of only two who did a site inspection. I believe a site inspection is essential. Their quote was the cheapest and best value by a good margin. They went to a lot of trouble with alternative panel placement plans. On installation day I agreed to an additional extra $700 for installation partly because I wanted to change the panel placing for a fourth time and partly because they had made a mistake regarding inverter location. After the extra charge they were still the best price but not by such a huge margin, but then the others may have ended up more expensive especially the ones who did not do site inspection.What they did well* Offered quality and value for money components and I believe genuine honest advice* Good price.* Very through and meticulous about installation quality.What they could improve on- The site inspector did not understand the rules properly about allowed Inverter placement.  However every company who quoted made the same mistake as they all got good photos of the proposed location. Why spend the money on a site inspection and send someone who gets it wrong.- The installation planning team did not properly study the information and photos that they had before arriving on site. As a result they wasted time when they arrived and it is possible we could have got slightly better panel placement.- The person who did the inspection did not seem to be familiar with how the installation team fix the panels. He needs to go out on a few jobs even assist on some jobs. He could then give better advice to customers and to the installation planning team.The end result was a quality job but it could have gone smoother and quicker. Better planning almost always pays for itself.

Frank provided a fast quote at a good price, clearly explaining my options and expected performance from my new solar arrays. Installation was arranged for a Saturday morning and was all over by lunchtime. The team worked quickly and efficiently and did a very neat installation. Follow up by an electrical inspector confirmed a very well done job. Would happily recommend Space Solar, in fact my friend is now getting a similar sytem installed by Space Solar,based on my recommendation and having seen the work done.

Had a 6.51KW system, (13 x Trina 310 panels facing North), (8 x Trina 310 facing West), 5kw Sungrow inverter SG5K-D. System works really well, I have little bit of shading on the North side late in the day, and on the West early in the morning. Otherwise I think the system performs very well. Solar Victoria arranged an audit, the only item which required rectification was the inverter was missing a locking screw, despite this being a really small fix the company came and fixed it within a few weeks.The purchasing process was a very straightforward and the sales rep was happy to assist throughout the process, and answer questions post installation, as well as arranged inspection and liaised with my retailer to get it connected to the grid. (note there was a 7 week lag between installation and grid connection, mostly due to schedule of inspector, and time it took inspector to issue COES after inspection).The only feedback is they didn't really discuss the minor shading issue, and provide options such as DC optimisers on some panels.They also don't provide a very detailed cost benefit analysis, but I had done one myself so wasn't a big deal.The installers came on time, were well mannered and clean, install looks great.cheers,

The system has not been installed yet, but I am very happy so far. The three companies which you recommended provided good advice with no high pressure tactics.The information on your web site is outstanding.
The sales and quoting process was quick and easy, the installation when it happened was all three of the above, the grid connection was in place as I already had a small system working.

The quote and sales process was easy and they were happy to tweak the system design a lot. The installation was quick, efficient and a quality job. Getting the rebate paper work and grid connection was easy. Great all round.
Waiting for new solar rebate to open to proceed.

I had a specific place I wanted my inverter and did not want any conduits visible from the outside. The installer was able to accomodate for both these requests and completed a neat installation of the inverter.
The solar quotes process worked seamlessly.Two of the the quotes provided were very competitive and very customer focused.Thanks for the great service.
Poor and misleading  communication about install period. Had to and still initiating following up myself. No follow up from installer.

You folk and Spacesolar were superb. Your information material and answers to my queries far exceeded my expectations and gave me the confidence to proceed. We could not have been more pleased with Spacesolar in every way from initial contacts, home visit, pre- Installation advice, the installation, and follow-up. Nothing has been too much trouble.We thoroughly recommend both organisations unequivocally.
This company was the only one I contacted that was prepared to be flexible with my choice of panels and invertor. Others were not even prepared to discuss options.

The team at Space Solar - particularly Frank in Sales, Matilda in Customer Service, and Peter in Processing are all knowledgeable and very responsive. They provided all the requested information readily and answered all my questions very promptly and comprehensively. This is the reason I chose Space Solar - they weren't going to leave me in the lurch. They also had very competitive pricing and quality products.Regarding installation, everything went smoothly on the day though the installation team did have some communication issues so it was complicated. For example, to get them to rotate the TV antenna so that birds don't sit on it and defecate on the new solar array. I had to draw a picture so it could be translated to the team on the roof. In addition, the panels were put on a brick patio and leaning against a brick wall, where they could get scratched. Had I known, I would have provided material for them to rest on until installation. Otherwise everything went smoothly and no tiles on the roof were broken.Regarding another company, it is almost impossible to get hold of them, you need to call on the dot of 8 am to have any chance. It has taken since late December 2018 and my rebate application has only now 20 Feb 2018, been approved.Space Solar was initially contacted late December and the system was installed 9 January, so wonderful!Regarding grid connection, that took about a month. It would depend on your electricity supplier. Overall everything is complex and does take time. Make sure you take accurate records because you will get heaps of files required for different purposes.

Hi Finn,Thanks for your assistance is getting through this rather confusing process. Your Web Site was very helpful in teasing out the many different issues. I was very happy with the professionalism of the installers and I'm enjoying watching the Kilowatt/hours mount up!

The consultation process was good and Reece was quite with my questions. Probably one negative thing is he did not try to configure my system with some North-facing solar panels to maximise production. My North-facing roof was not the best profile with any angles but I was able to put 8 panels. All panels were West-facing. My advise is to fully understand your roof profile and sun directions, it is important to do your own research instead relying fully on the sales consultant.Appointment of installation was quick and easy. The installers turned up on time and finished the installation without hassle. They also helped to trim the aluminium frame to be shortest possible.My system has been working perfectly and producing above average power.Since the recent reports in the news on Space Solar banned from participating in Victoria Solar Rebate program, 2 independents inspection were conducted by IT Power Australia and on behalf of Solar Victoria. There are a number of issues need to be resolved by Space Solar(i) Installer has drilled two holes on inverter to feed wires through instead of using designated port on the inverter,(ii) From these 2 holes, potential water ingress into inverter because they are not sealer properly,(iii) Panels are not earthed,(iv) Connectors need to be replaced as they are not from different manufacturer or supplier.These issues have not result for the inspector to shut down my system, which is a relieved. But it is disappointed with the quality of installation. In my opinion, if there is an inspection, please conduct them.I am waiting for the official report and Space Solar to action to rectify these issues.

Got the rebate and loan approved on Sept 4th round. Paid $600 deposit. During sales, I was not informed that the 330W Trina Solar panels were not in stock. I had to chase up everytime to know any update. Except for the sales person Reece nobody really cared to even update or do anything about it. Waited 2 months and they still dont have any date when they will get the stock. The last time I spoke I was told early November. No accurate date was provided.  I had to cancel the order. Now need to go through some other provider and the rebate process.

Made it easy. Initial contact with Reece was excellent as no-nonsense, informative and very knowledgeable and responsive. Installation crew were very friendly, quick and did a great job. They even showed up on a 36 degree day on a Saturday to do the job so am very impressed with this company. Also accounts staff very flexible and told them I couldn't pay on the day as weekend and gave me ample time to pay fully. Overall, very happy about system which is performing better than expected and have recommended to a friend.

They were comparable to others on price and quality of products.Unfortunately they do not keep you up to date with the paperwork, booking of the installation or booking of the electrical inspector. I had to wait over 10 weeks to just get a certificate of electrical safety and am still waiting for them to finalise the distributors works.I needed to chase them to sort out an installation date.I needed to chase them to get the electrical inspector out.First electrical inspection failed and electrician was required to come back to fix their work.

Space Solar were the most helpful in:- addressing our (many) questions during the quotation process- explaining what was (or wasn't) technically feasible/advisable - e.g. in terms of array configuration- adapting their proposal to various concerns (e.g. shadowing) that we identified- highly transparent with their pricing model/formula.In retrospect, however, a site visit as part of the quotation process would have been advisable, as there were unplanned changes to the system on installation day. We understand that site visits as part of quotation would add to their general business costs.In the end we are happy with the system as installed - although with slightly south facing panels we suspect that the mid-winter performance will be very poor (the upside is that it's particularly good in mid-summer - e.g. best performance so far is 45kWh in a day).

Frank (salesperson) was great. Answered all my stupid questions.Installers were great. Just bit messy after - but they were quick, must have been busy to go to next installation.They did everything as promised. Thanks guys! Loving the free electricity during the day!Now, just waiting for Energy Safe Victoria inspection then I can get my feed-in tariff...They said up to 5 weeks before Energy Safe inspector will contact me, due to backlog.

Sales person very patient, i ask thousand of questions over 6 months period. I believe i get value for my money (or should i say Victorian goverment money)Installation took over 2 days due to heavy rain, very neat  and installed inverter at location i prefer.
Space Solar sales actually worked with us to provide the right solution. I did my due diligence, which came handy while requesting information and asking questions

Space solar were good, they communicated well, gave lots of information, and answered my questions quickly, very happy to have gone with them. Install was quick and on schedule and I should now be connected to the grid, so I'm pretty happy with everything.
Easy to deal with and very competitive proposal. The process was explained clearly.
Not installed yet, waiting for installation date.
Good service, timely with good follow up and done with the minimum of fuss.

These guys where great, responsive, competitive and excellent workmanship. They explained everything and provided their mobile numbers to call for any issues after they left.  I highly recommend you get a quote from Chris.
quotation via mailinstallation delay for 1 week due to lack of work. they are Polite and Tidy.do after just 9 days after installation, not ready to get connected with grid yet.
Sales person Reece was great over phoneAnd always ready to help.Could call about any questions any timeWould recommend
Very good service from Space Solar to set up the system although system has developed a fault which I am currently working through with them. Sungrow Inverter with Trina Panels.

Installed LG panels 42x360 and Fronius inverter. I do have limited roof area and some of the panels required optimizers.I was able to match prices but others gave quotation over the phone without proper site inspection, was worried after agreement they add on.

Sales staff was excellent, answering questions on email even on weekends after hours from iPhone.Follow up service was also fantastic.My only criticism was that the installers, which were great, only one of the 3 had English and that was quite limited.They were very genuine however and with a bit of patience we were fine. Couldn't ask for nicer installers.
THARANGA is fantastic. Victor is good. The installers are good. Matilda is good too.
I have been talking Reece, he has been an excellent sales person so far. System hasn't installed yet but will let you guys know how that goes.

Space Solar didn't give us a fancy brochure like the others but the price was considerably cheaper (although it's hard to compare like-for-like). I had to take the initiative to get some answers as suggested by Solarquotes - particularly once I was getting into the paperwork for the state rebate -  but I was content with the information I got. I would have preferred more contact from Space Solar letting me know what the next step was or what was happening etc.I changed my mind a bit as I did more and more research and my requests for adjusted quotes were attended to with minimal fuss.Installation proceeded on the day scheduled although the planned layout wouldn't fit. Our friendly installers advised on a change that we were happy with.I feel like we got a good system for a good price.

Salesman was not pushy, unlike another company that didn't get the job However it was installed on schedule, the workers had good work ethic to get the job done efficiently system seems to function quite well. WiFi quite useful to see how the system is functioning  Waiting to get my feed in tariff setup.
Hi, yes you made things easy for me.
Thank you for providing the 3 quotes.

The sales guy was not pushy and talked me through his choose of equipment and why he recommended it.  He provided all the information I needed in order to apply for the Vic government solar rebate and went through what I needed to do to apply.The people installing it did a really good job. They asked about where I would like to have the inverter and accommodated my preferred placement.They did a thorough test and troubleshoot on the system, the first inverter was not working properly so they went back to the office and quickly got a replacement unit.They helped make sure that the wireless monitoring was setup and working.They replaced any tiles that were broken during installation (we have very old cement tiles that break easy) with the tiles I had provided.They cleaned up after themselves and we're friendly.

Recently I have installed a solar PV system with Space Solar under Solar Quotes recommenced.Their service very excellent. Every friendly and helpfully to explain any questions thatâ€™s I have asked.At the first day, I was so impressed about consulting by Mr Reece. He kept in touch all the time. Gave me lot of information that I havenâ€™t known. Provided sufficiently paperwork for VIC rebates.Thank you so much for all you fantastic team work. And thankfully Mr peacock. Without him I wouldnâ€™t Know Space solar

Customer service score was only held back because the inspector found one small fault that required a revisit to fix. Remarkably, that happened within hours of the inspection.Altogether this has been a very happy experience. The decision on which system to go with was made easy by a very clear explanation of the alternatives. The installation went smoothly and the system is working to expectation.
Excellent service
I expected to wait 4 to 6 weeks for installation but it was less than a week after my deposit was paid. Excellent!

Good communication, easy to deal with. My installation done much sooner than expected and installers were very skilled and well organized. They clearly explained everything I needed to know after installation was complete. Highly recomended.
Your solar checklist helped us heaps in sorting and comparing.

The one thing I think Space Solar do very well over the competitors was choice.They recommended a couple of setups and also give you a price list of other panels and inverters they can source.  So for someone who has done too much research I could go make up a package and price the what if's.If you are new to solar they can guide you in choices from cheap to expensive.Actually all the installers I got quotes from spent time explaining the pros and cons.I have shading issue morning and afternoon which Nearmaps did not really show and hence not found by a few installers I got quotes from. Everyone missed the shading in the morning I have a couple of panels still in shade to around lunch time.Space Solar recommended Enphase although I could of went SolarEdge or optimisers with them.I spent a bit of time on plus and minus on each system with Tharanga and I installed a 6,6kw Enphase system with 22 Suntech panels facing North.Very interesting looking over panel level monitoring and watching the shading with the system.The team was very good Matilda sorted out the install very quick for me, system was installed 2 weeks from deposit. Which was great.Installers where very nice, great on the day had to move a couple of panels slightly once on the roof and pulling tiles.They cracked one tile although I had some replacements so all good.I hit 37kw+ 5 days in a row so happy with that for Melbourne Autumn :)So far 2 weeks in very happy. Just have to wait to get Inspected so I can get the export credits although this is out of Space Solars control.There are a lot of people getting Solar with the Vic Rebate

For your info, Space Solar are in Knoxfield not West Melbourne. Your information was most helpful, thanks. Space Solar were very good, negotiated a good price and all the products supplied were as quoted. Installation was great, could not fault the workmanship on an extremely hot day. Very happy with results.

Frank from space solar got in touch with us very quickly via phone. He then emailed us a quote and product information sheets tailored to what we discussed on the phone. He seemed genuine and honest and was very skilled with answering all our queries. After we had some time to think about the quote we asked him to visit us for a more in depth discussion which he was happy to do. He was fantastic and the price was very good for what we think is a great quality system. Our solar system will be scheduled for installation within the next three weeks.

All the quotes I got wouldn't come out to the house. All said "it's done via google earth these days". Spacesolar (installer) said all the right things and had a competitive price and in house installers. I paid my deposit before xmas and was told installation would be end of Jan start Feb but in new year it was scheduled for 19/2/19 then day before (3pm) they re-scheduled for 26/02/19. All up 3 to 4 weeks later than told. On the day four blokes turn up one who could speak English. The panel layout needed to be different and I could have fitted in at least another panel if not two which would have been picked up at a pre install visit. The one with English and another left for another job. The two left at my place did the job. They use whatever roof battens you have on your roof so the panels are not aligned like in the pretty pictures. My panels poke over the ridge line which can be disappointing. The installers drilled a whole in the roof they didn't need to and were generally pretty rough with everything and with no safety measures but they got the job done. When it came to the time to install the monitoring system (Enphase enlighten) they couldn't help, no instructions, they pass you the phone to the guy who can speak English  which didn't help much. Lucky it's pretty easy to do. Then they pass you some papers to sign, don't leave you with a copy. Not a lot of detail. They pack up and leave you with the mess they made. Who knows it could have been worse. I'd recommend picking good products Enphase, Fonius etc (not Solaredge) and insisting on a roof placement inspection before installation.

So far, they were attentive, good follow up re: Sales installation went well - BUT panels were walked on, some are twisted, better installation position would have mitigated shadow from a neighbours tree in the morning. Some panels have marks (like a scratch ?) and a discolouration patch. Emailed the company with pics and waiting for their response about how they intend to rectify / remedy these issues

Being new to all these, I've actually got few quotes from different installers. After much comparison, was truly happy with what Space Solar offered me in terms of pricing & product.Also, a great help was the representative Reece Valvo who was extremely patient with me & all my questions. He was straight forward & honest with his quotes.I'm also very happy with the 2 installers. They did a great job, even assisted to help replace a broken tile that they noticed. Point to note that Space Solar uses their own installers too.Worst experience was with Euro Solar (now Sunrise Solar)! Lies after lies from their representatives who are Samuel & Brett.

Very happy with SpaceSolar, good price (not cheapest, but their price includes everything, no hidden fee).Excellent sales, helpful and patient (very thanks Reece).A little bit long waiting time for installation, but still in their time frame (4 ~ 6 weeks).Just few days generation record for 6.1kw Trina solar panels + 5kw Sungrow inverter:Cloudy day: ~20KwhSunny day: ~38kwh
Definitely recommend using Space Solar for your solar install. Their before and after service has been great.

Communication with the installers was a real issue.  English was obviously not their first language and they seemed reluctant to talk at all.  Had a real issue with them not finishing on the scheduled day and then uncertainty about when it would be completed.On value for money.  Well another company (not on you list) quoted the same panels  but with micro inverters in lieu of a string inverter.  Taking out the inverter cost differential they were still some $3500 more expensive. Space solar's cost was otherwise marginally better (5%) than the others.

Provided prompt on site assesment for quotation.No push telemarketing.Provided a written quote that was complete and transparent.Used inhouse employees.Offered quality value for money mono solar panels and fronius inverter.On acceptance of quotation I received a welcome pack next steps checklist. This covered important items including preapprovals, STC, EWR and CES.Arrived on time on agreed date.Supervisor consulted on location of panels and inverter and suggested improvements.Completely professional in the assembly and setup process.Provided all documentation for panels, inverter and design.The quotation, the installation and subsequent activities were done with a high level of professionalism, diligence and transparence.The experience was so good I wish I could always purchase this way in other areas.

Had my system installed 3 weeks ago. Happy with my experience. Tharanga was knowledgeable and responsive to my emails. Installers spent the extra time to put the inverter in my preferred location and did a neat job.

Paul from Space Solar came to my place and showed me the panel layouts and position on the roof. I now have the best panels and a good inverter and quiet happy with Paul and Sapce Solar. Thank you to Paul and the two friendly installers who came to my place and did a wonderful job for me.Farnoush

Have had a great experience with Space Solar. There was a wait time for the installation, several weeks however, I was informed of this due to high demand and the time of the year. I had several quotes and found Space Solar to be comparable to most. The company is great to deal with and Reece (Sales Rep) was excellent in his service as I had many questions and he not only answered all of them but in a short time frame as well.The installers arrived on time and finished slightly earlier than expected. They friendly and helped with the mobile application and WiFi setup of the Inverter.  You can see why these guys are in the top 5 rated installers on Solar Quotes.

Frank Gao was my consultant. He has been very patient and honest with me on pricing, pro and con, what are my best options. I got the pricing formula which allow me to look at price impact on different panels and inverters, plus 3 examples of system with lower price system, more expensive system. My site has complicated roof line and tree shading.At the end, I am down to Space Solar and another company. He has not talked down the other competitor which offer a SolarEdge system which I respect his integrity. Space solar probably is not the cheapest. The other company is a bit cheaper ~5-10%. At the end I choose Space Solar mainly of my experiences with the consultant. Installation time, is within a week from down payment on a Sunday. (I think they have a vacant slot for some reason) The guys are still installing the system now.

The guys who installed were not great. Small details in their workmanship were well below expectations. They didn't communicate well with me and were so rushed for time that they did not even brief me on the system they had installed and how i could work with it. As such I am left having to google many questions.Also, I think there is a fault in my system. It constantly and very regularly cuts out and resets itself (several times over the space of minutes).On a positive, the sales guy was excellent. Time will tell if his after sales are as good as his pre sales.

I found out, after the system had been installed, that the grid voltage at my house frequently exceeds the regulation of 253 v max. Consequently the inverter frequently trips because of high AC grid voltage.Some week since the installation date and 5 days since complaining to United Energy (U E)  I am still waiting for U E to commence a recorded check of the voltage - a precursor, I was advised, before they will take any corrective action. To date therefore the solar system has been practically worthless--- the periods it has been shut down have exceeded those when it has been generating.The message to any body considering solar is to first check whether the voltage at your residence complies with Australian regulations of 230 v + 10%, - 5%.The quality of Space Solar's work was fine but communications on technical aspects was a bit tortuous because English is a 2nd language to some of their personnel.

Installation was done wrong and had to be changed. Left framework of wrong installation still on roof. Many cracked tiles. System not working to performance expected 70% efficency instead of sold 80%. No follow up so far from company to check all is working as was dark when finished on the day. Waited 2 weeks for safety checks. Still waiting for paperwork and meter reconfiguration so not sure how long. Sales person Frank was very good.
Largely hassle free.  I can recommend Space Solar.
Good service, not sure if I got the best price though.
Still awaiting electrical company for prices.

A couple of small things:- The sales team weren't accurate with the timing of the rebate. There is actually some delay in getting all the paperwork required to apply for a rebate, including waiting for an inspection for the CES certificate. It was suggested that all paperwork will be supplied as soon as the install was completed.- The sales team said that I will be able to monitor individual appliances on my Solar inverter through the Fronius app. The installation team were surprised to hear this and said it's not possible.- I was hoping to get some great insights on the app. I was convinced that I will but the Fronius inverter app is really crappy and disappointing. It could be a lot better.The above are just suggestions for improvement, but I'd like to stress that Reece, the sales person, was really professional and responsive. Overall a really good experience.Thanks for having this service available
Itâ€™s been five weeks now that I am waiting for the appointment to get it installed. Itâ€™s a bit longer than I thought it would be.
Has not been fitted yet. Installation date 26/03/18
Overall is good.Need to improve the quality of installation work.

As recommended we approached 3 suppliers off your list . The actual choice was between 2 , & the chosen supplier was a little more expensive , but included micro-inverters  . Thanks for your help - I have already told a friend about your web site & how helpful it has been

We are about to sign the contract and pay the deposit. Space Solar is not pushy and listened to my concerns on shading and came up with what we think is the solution for us. I would not hesitate in recommending them. Finn I would like to thank you and your staff for following up, the information on your web site was a big help.
Really pleased with process and outcome - highly recommended
I had a great experience with all 3 suppliers, it was very difficult to choose who to go with.
Really good installers and the sales process was not pushy and tailored to my requirements.
Strong to recommend Space Solar to install the house Solar System with the reasonable price and good quality product.
Installation team needs to be more careful with gutters etc but they were generally good.

The whole team from  Sales, Administration and installers were fantastic. They were informative, communicative and the theinstaller team was avery hardworking group without any fuss. Thanks to Frank Ga from Sales, Matilda from Admin, Leslie from Finance, Gerry,Rich ,Ding from Installionand Victor from Technical, are all very helpful. It was a wonderful experience.

SpaceSolar were a great company to deal with, very impressed indeed. Right from Frank in Sales to Sarah in admin they were very responsive & professional all the way through the project. The installers were a feat to watch, they started before 9am, and the system (with 13 panels) was up and running by 2:45pm. So very happy with SpaceSoar, I have recommended them to others interested in solar.

Was told I would be contacted in 2-4 weeks for install, after 5 weeks I had to call them to get install date.  Have constant emails from system, indicating a fault, but space solar has not replied to me after a week as to what is wrong with system. installers were very good.

I will recommend Space Solar to anyone. Their quote was reasonable and customer care was great. Installation date was postponed a couple of times due to the weather conditions. The installers completed their work in one day and the system started working next day itself. In a week I have consumed 43% less energy from the grid.Waiting for the installers to send the paperwork to get feed-in tariff from my electricity supplier and also to claim the newly introduced rebate from VIC government.
Have just installed today so will know more about the system as time goes by
The Salesperson I dealt with was excellent. I feel he gave us an outstanding service and top quality product that suited our interests and requirements.

Overall a fairly simple process and so far happy with results. Ended up with 11 north facing panels and 8 west facing. A little perturbed when the installers arrived and suggested that the design could have been improved...salesman vs technicians? Also needed to change inverter location.Installation took less than 8 hours and was hassle free. 4 workers. No broken tiles. Neat job. Good clean up.Direct monitory on iphone works. I have had a little bit of trouble with remote monitoring but supplier has been active in trying to improve situation. May be simply to do with locations of Inverter and modem.It is a bit early to be too glowing about the system as it is only a fortnight old, it as been very cloudy, and I am not yet in receipt of feed in tarriff. However, preliminary signs are hopeful. Time will tell.

Very happy with solar system that we have its Trina panel and Fronius inverter from the beginning meeting with the sales Frank Gao was helping us and down to the installations team was doing fantastic job installing the panel and give much credit to Jerry the electrician for taking his time for making sure all the wires was properly and install. We would be more than happy to recommending this company to our friends and families. as of today we have starting to enjoying the power production by our panel.
Price locked in. Waiting for house handover to do the installation.
Frank was very responsive and informative. Highly recommended as he gave me lots of advice and variety in terms of my budget and the system I should go with.
Frank Gao was the salesman from space solar, he patiently work us through with all the process.

Space Solar delivered all they said they would from the first meeting to the installation. I was happy with the sales approach and the support with minor changes that were all delivered on installation day. Also pleased with the final result and the team that got the job done in the cold and sometimes wet weather.

All went smoothly and to plan. Would recommend  to others.Thanks for providing the companies to quote, all turned up on time and presented their cases in a professional manner.This was of great help to me. We learnt a lot throughout this process.

Hi Frank / VictorWe would like to provide you with our feedback on our solar installation. After receiving a knock on the door from another solar company that really didnâ€™t provide a satisfactory solution we contacted a solar specialist who recommended your firm.From our first contact with you we were very impressed  with your knowledge and the fact that you concentrated on providing a solution rather than just trying to sell a product.The installation was completed very professionally in May 2018 and we are very pleased with the performance  and output of the 6kw system and battery. Our usage from the grid has dramatically decreased even though we are still in the winter months of Melbourne.
